# Xylum

> Xylum is one app that runs a small service business. It keeps clients, quotes, projects, hours, invoices and costs in one place. It does the routine work every night, and what it writes for a person waits as a draft until that person says yes. It is invitation only for now.

Xylum is made by Sylvaris. It is built for independent consultants, freelancers, and small studios and agencies: people who sell their time and their skill.

Key facts:

- One record for each client. Every app points to it, so nothing is typed twice.
- Every night Xylum closes quotes that ran out, raises repeating charges, warns before a domain, certificate or licence runs out, moves contracts on when their dates come, and drafts a reminder when a late invoice is due one.
- Most apps open on one sentence that says what matters, not on a dashboard of numbers.
- What Xylum writes for a person waits as a draft until they say yes. The assistant cannot approve its own work. Xylum can send payment reminders on its own only after a person switches that on.
- Changes to records go in an audit log. Xylum cannot edit or delete an entry: the database refuses it.
- One step turns an accepted quote into a draft invoice with its lines filled in. Each project shows hours logged against its plan.
- The assistant runs on a model from Anthropic. The key stays on the server, never in the app or its database.
- Nearly every app has its own screens, API and agent tools. An outside AI assistant can work with Xylum over MCP: it can read and make edits that can be undone, and it cannot send or delete.
- More than one company can live under one sign-in, each with its own records. Most apps can be switched off, company by company.
- Five languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and French. Not every screen is translated yet.
- Xylum is not an accounting system. It does not keep the ledger or file taxes. The accountant does.
- Xylum is not for factories, warehouses or large firms with many departments.
- Prices are not set yet.
- Sign-up is by invitation only for now. Anyone can ask for an invitation on the signup page.

## The apps

- Work: Projects, Timesheets, Calendar, Todo, Helpdesk, Booking, Wiki
- Money: Sales, Invoicing, Expenses, Subscriptions, Contracts, Purchasing, Reports
- People and records: Contacts, CRM, Catalog, Templates, Library
- Personal: Finance, Inventory
- Platform: System, Portal
